INK is looking to provide an environment where artists can produce animated content by experimenting with a range of AI-enabled tools and production pipelines. jobs.titleRaw: Software Engineer 5— Platform Modernization Engineering
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the Team

The Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) — Migrations team exists to accelerate Netflix's ability to evolve its infrastructure by driving safe, scalable migrations across the stack. We reduce engineering toil, eliminate technical debt, and enable teams to move forward with confidence as Netflix's technology continues to evolve at pace.

We are not a feature delivery team. We are a revenue protector and accelerator — through our work we enable faster feature delivery, innovation, and security protection across the entire engineering organization.

Netflix operates one of the most sophisticated and high-scale engineering platforms in the world. Keeping that platform on the leading edge requires continuous, intentional modernization. The Paved Path — our curated set of recommended, well-supported infrastructure standards — is constantly advancing as Netflix pushes into new technical territory. Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We operate in pods (3–6 month cycles), partnering closely with the most strategically critical initiatives across Infrastructure Engineering. We build the automation and tooling that lets us execute these at a scale and speed no manual effort could match, including AI-assisted code modification pipelines and fleet-wide orchestration systems.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering
Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling
Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design
Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy
Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence
Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

Required Experience

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We provide centralized data platforms and tools for various business functions at Netflix, enabling teams to utilize data to make critical, data-driven decisions. We focus on making it easy for our business partners to work with data efficiently, securely, and responsibly. We aspire to set the industry standard in building a world-class data infrastructure, supporting Netflix’s vision to be the most popular and widely accessible destination for global internet entertainment.

As the Data Platform charter grows, we are expanding our presence to Poland to further increase our impact. We are seeking Distributed Systems Engineers to help evolve and innovate our Product and Infrastructure. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that brings new perspectives as we address the next set of challenges.

Team Spotlights

Data Platform Online Data Stores Team

This team will focus on taking end-to-end ownership of the internal data platform products, including ZooKeeper, one of the critical infrastructure products in our suite, ensuring its continued reliability, scalability and evolution. Over time, this team will expand its charter to more datastores, and to drive broader infrastructure initiatives. This expansion reinforces our mission to boost Netflix engineers’ productivity and innovation by providing a robust, efficient, and secure data platform, while fostering close collaboration between data platform teams to deliver greater organizational throughput and agility.

Experimentation Platform

This team owns the data infrastructure that makes A/B testing work at Netflix. Specifically, they build and maintain the systems that store and govern the record of who was in which experiment, across hundreds of concurrent tests running across streaming, ads, growth, and device platforms. They also own the semantic layer that ties every experiment metric at Netflix back to that allocation data, and the pipelines that keep the whole thing fresh and reliable. As the team matures, the scope grows to include self-service tooling for the teams running experiments and support for AI-driven monitoring and analysis workflows.

Data Movement

The Data Movement Connector EcoSystem at Netflix is a growing domain with an expanding charter to own all the new high-leverage business-critical connectors across Netflix. The team currently offers Frameworks, Libraries, and Control Planes and supports a large set of streaming/incremental and batch/snapshot-based connectors. We believe having the Poland team build and own a set of connectors to move and integrate data across different business domains would be the fastest way to unlock business values. The team will also build the automated systems integration test framework (for batch and streaming connectors). This offers an excellent opportunity to learn the technology stack and deliver direct, relevant impact across the organization.

This could be a great opportunity for you if you enjoy:

  • Solving business needs at scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills

  • Designing and building robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure

  • Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and technical program managers across teams

  • Sharing experiences with open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS

About you:

  • 7 or more years of experience designing and building complex, scalable distributed data infrastructure

  • Proficiency in Java, C++, Python, or Scala, with a solid understanding of multi-threading and memory management

  • Experience with the Spark platform is valuable

  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining impactful systems

  • Experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

  • You have developed your skills through a variety of educational or professional experiences in computer science, engineering, or a related field

  • Nice to have: front-end engineering skills

A few more things about us:
As a team, we come from many different backgrounds and countries. Our fields of education range from the humanities to engineering to computer science, and we strive to give people the opportunity to take on different roles, should they choose to. We believe that this diversity and adaptability have helped us build an inclusive and empathetic environment, and we look forward to adding your perspective.

Our culture is unique, and we tend to live by our values, so it’s worth learning more about Netflix here.

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Data Science and Engineering organization:

Data Science and Engineering (DSE) is a key pillar of Netflix’s data-driven strategy, leveraging data, analytics, experimentation, models, and consumer insights to inform decisions. DSE focuses on data engineering, metrics, analysis, dashboards, analytic tools, experimentation research, and analytics. The team also develops models and algorithms for internal decision support.

We are committed to using data to inform our decision-making as we work toward our mission. This involves curating data across various domains, such as Growth, Finance, Product, Content, and Studio. All of this data collection and curation is made possible thanks to Netflix’s talented Data Engineers, who bring this data to life.

About Data Engineering:

Data Engineering at Netflix involves building systems to process data efficiently and modeling data to power analytics. These solutions range from batch data pipelines that bring business metrics to life, to real-time processing services that integrate with our core product features. Data Engineers benefit from a strong understanding of large distributed systems on which our data solutions rely. Candidates should have experience across several of these skill sets and depth in at least one area. Effective communication skills are important, as you will collaborate with business, engineering, and data science teams to foster a culture of learning.

We are hiring for the first time for the Data Engineering organization in EMEA, across the following teams:

Conversation, Marketing, and Fandom

The reach of Netflix and the fandom we create fuels the “Netflix effect” - a virtuous cycle of great content and intense fandom that catapults our stories into the cultural conversation. Netflix influences what people around the world search for and talk about, the music they listen to, the books they read, the countries they visit, and how they dress. 

Our marketing efforts help to kick start the Netflix effect, and we are providing more and more ways for fans to engage with our stores: Tudum, events like Netflix Bites and Bridgerton experiences, and the launch in 2025 of the first two Netflix House locations. 

Netflix is a data-driven company, and we are hiring multiple data engineers to increase our data support for marketing and fandom activities around the world. The opportunity for impact in these roles is enormous: Netflix social media channels generate more than 100B impressions a year, we are expanding fandom into the real world, and we’ve barely scratched the surface of the data available to support these activities.

Member Data Engineering

The Netflix product experience helps our members discover the next great piece of content to enjoy.  It could be a new series, an old movie, a live event people are talking about, or even a new video game. The product aims to present the right content, in the right format, to the right people, at the right time. When we do this well, Members value Netflix and continue to subscribe, despite the many other choices for entertainment. This team creates the data products that help measure this experience, track key metrics, and support innovation decisions through A/B testing.  You will partner closely with engineering teams to refine the client and server logging that serves as a foundation for our analytic datasets, and work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers using this data to identify new opportunities and test out new ideas.  

What have you done and what do you know? 

  • 6 years of experience building data pipelines in batch and/or real-time settings to support a variety of use cases. Our data sources vary in size, from smaller sources to very large sources. Experience with Spark, Flink, Iceberg, and Kafka is helpful but not strictly required.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for scripting, automation, and data orchestration frameworks, as well as the ability to write complex SQL (any variant) for ad-hoc and recurring workflows. You strive to write clear and maintainable code and are comfortable learning new technologies.

  • Ability to model data efficiently for reporting and metrics, and to organize data for scale and fast retrieval.

  • Experience sourcing and modeling data from application APIs and event streams.

  • Experience converting business requirements into data engineering workstreams, enabling insights that empower colleagues to make informed decisions.

  • Experience mentoring and supporting other team members, navigating ambiguity, and creating clarity.

What will you do?

  • Take ownership of critical pipelines and data sets to support a variety of use cases in data science and engineering.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs, model tables using data warehouse best practices, and develop data pipelines to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data.

  • Creatively explore how to use data to continually add value to Netflix. Translate ambiguous business questions into clear data requirements, and deliver on them.

  • Serve as a connector between data engineering and the business, enabling insights that empower colleagues to make informed decisions.

  • Build strong partnerships with data scientists, analytics engineers, and machine learning practitioners to enable research and insight delivery for the business.

Who are you? 

  • Able to work both independently and collaboratively across functions (e.g., data scientists, product managers).

  • Able to adapt to different work environments and see yourself as a partner in the business, with the shared goal of moving it forward.

  • You have a growth mindset, are curious, authentic, self-motivated, determined, and generous in giving and receiving feedback to foster growth for yourself and those around you.

  • Open to new perspectives, able to engage in thoughtful discussions, and adapt as new information emerges.

  • An effective communicator who can break down and explain complex data problems in clear, concise language
